  context={"endpoint"}

Copies the tables named from the Data Map's file, as sent, into the linked Database node's schema.json, each converted to the node's database and replacing the table of the same name, then commits it and reloads the runtime. A table with a column that has no type there isn't copied, and the notes say why. The database itself isn't changed.
